name: Wankai New Materials Co., Ltd.
summary: Wankai New Materials Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and sale of polyethylene terephthalate (PET) raw materials in China and internationally. The company offers Bottle-Grade Polyester Chips used in the production of bottle packaging containers, such as water bottles, beverage bottles, edible oil bottles, cosmetic bottles, etc. It also provides non-bottle-grade PET chips, including super bright PET raw material for BOPET film, PET polymer to produce fiber or filament yarn, and polyester PET chips for producing photovoltaic back films.
